## Apple briefly hits $5 trillion market cap, becoming only the second company ever to reach the milestone after Nvidia

The $5T threshold carries passive-flow mechanics: index-weight recalibrations at this scale affect broad market dynamics. The Apple-vs-Nvidia cap race is a real-time referendum on consumer platform durability versus AI hardware infrastructure — a direct read on which thesis the market is pricing more richly right now.

- Apple's market capitalization briefly touched $5 trillion for the first time, a milestone confirmed by ten outlets.
- Apple joins Nvidia as the only two companies ever to reach a $5 trillion valuation.
- The move was characterized as brief across coverage, with no indication of sustained hold at the level.
- The cluster frames a nascent competition between Apple and Nvidia for market-cap leadership at this threshold.
